summary: The rendered output preserves the general certificate layout, but several important data and representation issues remain: a top-right identifier is missing, the official ministry/department names are mistranslated, the transaction code values appear wrong, blank table cells are filled with “None,” and a prominent certifier signature/mark is omitted. Some source values, especially transaction codes and bottom-left footer text, are blurry enough to require human confirmation.
matches_well: Overall logical structure is preserved: header, title, photograph/thumb areas, landowner details, property table, and footer sections are present.
Landowner name, husband’s name, citizenship number, issued date, issued office, and main address fields mostly match the source.
The three property rows, plot numbers, ward/map information, ownership type, tenant name, land class, and total area are generally represented in the correct table structure.
Use of placeholder boxes for coat of arms, photograph, thumb impressions, and signatures is generally appropriate in principle.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows an additional identifier above it, “PF002728503” under the Nepali landowner/code number label, as well as “NM०००००९५” below.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Only shows “Land Ownership Certificate No.: NM0000095”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source header reads “भूमि व्यवस्था, सहकारी तथा गरिबी निवारण मन्त्रालय” and “भूमि व्यवस्थापन तथा अभिलेख विभाग”, i.e. Land Management/Cooperatives/Poverty Alleviation ministry and Land Management/Archive department, not the rendered ministry/department names.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Header reads “Ministry of Land Reform and Management” and “Department of Land Reform and Management”.

discrepancies.location: table, evidence/transaction code cells for all three plot entries
discrepancies.source_observation: The source appears to show a different code, likely “ML00000XY”/similar, not “ML00000088”. The scan is somewhat blurry, so this value needs confirmation.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Each transaction code is rendered as “ML00000088”.

discrepancies.source_observation: The corresponding cells in the source appear blank; no “None” value is printed.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The Register Page No. cells contain “None” for each entry.

discrepancies.location: right side of table, certifier/signature column
discrepancies.source_observation: The source contains a prominent red handwritten signature/mark crossing the right-side certifier/signature area.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The certifier signature column is blank.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source photograph area is a wider landscape-oriented rectangle; the placeholder does not roughly match the source aspect/size.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Photograph placeholder is a tall, narrow portrait box.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source includes additional bottom-left office/section text and a signature line; some of the printed/handwritten content is not represented beyond a generic signed placeholder.
The source uses Devanagari digits for the total “४३३२.०९” and does not clearly show an added “A.D.” marker near the date.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Total area is rendered as “4332.09” and print date includes “A.D.”
